name: System volume level
plain: No API tells a page how loud the device volume is.
meaning: Volume is OS state. Proxies exist: autoplay policy shows a muted tab, audio output device changes fire devicechange, and a muted video can still play. A page cannot read a 0 to 100 level.

access.persistence: read fresh on every page load; nothing stored
access.iframe: Readable from cross-origin iframes too (same values)

fields.name: proxy: autoplay policy
fields.range: play() rejection reveals no user activation, not volume

fields.name: proxy: devicechange event
fields.range: fires when headphones or Bluetooth output connect (enumerateDevices count)

fields.name: proxy: HTMLMediaElement.muted
fields.range: only the element's own flag, 0 or 1

fields.name: proxy: volume property
fields.range: element volume 0 to 1, not the system level

limits.headline: Can't see how loud your device volume is set
limits.user_action: Nothing. Pages have no way to ask for this
can: See if audio is blocked by autoplay rules
Tell when your audio output device changes
Play muted video even if sound is blocked
Set the volume of its own player
cannot: See your volume level from 0 to 100
Get a volume number; the browser has no way to ask
See the volume of other tabs or apps

story.what_it_is: No tool tells a page how loud your device volume is.
story.for_you: A website cannot see whether your volume is low or high. It can still see whether its own audio is muted or blocked by autoplay rules.
story.for_makers: Volume is a private device setting. Browsers keep it out of reach. Sites rely on autoplay rules and user buttons instead.

use_cases.example: A streaming site wanted to warn when your volume is off and shows an unmute button instead.
A browser game wanted the system volume to set sound levels and gives a volume slider.
A video advertiser wanted to measure audible ads and uses player mute state.
A web music player wanted the device volume and shows its own volume control.
An exam site wanted to detect silent rooms and cannot read volume.
A live stream shows a tap to unmute button when autoplay is muted.
A tracker wanted volume as a device clue and cannot get it.

risks: Muted state is visible to the page

legit_uses: None: the browser deliberately withholds it
abuse: Sites attempt proxies to recover it
